humanAcceptance.evidence: Dave's current instruction after immutable PR #51 preview artifact 9020910443 became available at source SHA df330132ee34b36e30f6a5b85c20ab6a8171bd40 is: 'Just get it live on GitHub pages ... Then I can preview it that way.' This is explicit publication authorization for that exact artifact; Dave has not claimed a pre-publication manual browser inspection. requirements.summary: Field Kit cards and the selected-primary inspector remain readable at four core metrics
requirements.expected: Asset-backed Field Kit weapon cards and the selected-primary inspector display Damage, Range, Fire Rate, and Magazine inside their bounds without duplicate DPS, wallbang, or expandable extra-ballistics density.
requirements.falsifier: A served Field Kit card hides or clips its four-metric deck, loses the asset-backed weapon still, duplicates DPS/wallbang, or restores the expandable extra-ballistics block.

evidence.note: The exact candidate Chromium contract passed all six Field Kit/menu tests and checks four metrics per card, four selected-primary stats, asset-backed stills, computed layout, and bounded desktop/mobile surfaces.
The immutable PR #51 preview artifact is the byte-bound visual target for the Field Kit presentation; no claim is made that Dave inspected it in a browser.

requirements.expected: The authored mirrored arm rig solves wrist and palm targets in parent space with a deterministic anti-parallel axis while preserving hip, ADS, prone, reload, recoil, melee, wall-clearance, firearm contact, and knife contact contracts.
requirements.falsifier: An anti-parallel bone direction produces a non-finite or arbitrary flip, or arm reach/contact, ADS framing, prone clearance, reload, melee, or knife/socket alignment regresses in the served matrix.

evidence.note: Focused orientation, anatomy, viewmodel, character presentation, and runtime contracts pass on the exact candidate.
The exact candidate browser matrix passed authored arms, firearm, reload, melee, prone/wall-clearance, both hand contacts, and knife contact at 1440p, 4K, and ultrawide.

requirements.expected: The game admits portrait and landscape touch play without a rotate blocker; movement, look, FIRE, reload, jump, crouch, grenade, melee, interact, pause, and compact HUD regions remain inside the viewport without rectangle intersections, and touch FIRE admits a semi-automatic shot without desktop pointer lock.

requirements.summary: The first WebGL flare shot stays responsive and does not serialize a host checkpoint on the shot frame
requirements.expected: The compatibility renderer prewarms the exact retained flare fire presentation without a live dynamic point-light shader-key change, the first real shot remains within the preserved frame-gap bound, and non-forced checkpoint creation/storage occurs only in the deferred idle task.
requirements.falsifier: The real first shot exceeds the relative/fixed frame-gap ceiling, performs a synchronous host-checkpoint storage write, spends 250 ms or more inside the fire call, or restores a live WebGL flare PointLight topology change.

evidence.note: The exact candidate passed the real first-shot frame-gap probe, synchronous Storage.setItem falsifier, bounded fire-call assertion, finite-ammo admission, active projectile check, game-owned presented-frame advance, and changed compositor-region pixels without replacing timing with a fixed-delay claim.
The exact candidate proves deferred gameplay checkpoint serialization, forced lifecycle persistence, WebGL no-dynamic-light topology, and bounded first-shot presentation prewarm.
